tools.name: try_sample
tools.description:
Labeled sample of what an account gets: a pixel, a consent receipt and two contacts.

        Needs no account and no key. Every record is synthetic and marked so.
        Call this first to show the person what AgentPixel returns, then call signup_free.

tools.name: signup_free
tools.description:
Start a 30-day trial, no card. After that, $1 per account per month for 3 pixels and 500 new contacts per UTC calendar month.

        Sends a 6-digit code to the email address. Returns account_id and signup_token; keep both.
        Next: ask the person for the 6-digit code in the AgentPixel email,

tools.name: confirm_signup
tools.description:
Confirm the email with the 6-digit code, or check whether the email link was clicked.

        Preferred: confirm_signup(account_id, code, signup_token). The first confirmation returns api_key; store it, it is shown once.
        Link clicked instead: call confirm_signup(account_id, signup_token) ev

tools.name: resend_code
tools.description:
Send a new 6-digit code to the email of an existing account.

        Use it when the code expired, was lost or was entered wrong 5 times. Limits: 1 per minute, 5 per day.
        The old code stops working. With an expired signup_token, use the new code on POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/signup-toke

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description:
Issue an API key after the email is confirmed.

        Not needed when confirm_signup already returned api_key. Each call issues another key, so call it once.
        Returns the key once. Store it securely and attach it to the connection.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description:
Which account this connection's API key belongs to.

        status is the account state after email confirmation. plan is "free" (the trial plan id) during the 30-day trial,
        paid after the subscription, or unlimited for internal accounts. trial_ends_at is when the trial ends.
        key_pr

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description:
Whether this account can use pixels and whether a tag is installed.

        setup_complete is true once at least one pixel's tag has been seen on
        its site. good_standing is the account, not the tag.

tools.name: list_pixels
tools.description: Pixels on this account. Each item has pixel_id, domain, and install_status.

tools.name: create_pixel
tools.description:
Create a pixel for a domain.

        Does not create an API key. The account must already be active.
        Next: call configure_consent(pixel_id, controller_name, purposes) and install the snippet it returns.
        Do not install a snippet before consent is configured. install_status starts as

tools.name: get_pixel
tools.description: One pixel, including the HTML snippet to paste on its site.

tools.name: check_install
tools.description:
Fetch the pixel's homepage and store whether the tag is there.

        install_status becomes installed or not_installed. check_error says
        why a check could not decide. Evaluator accounts fetch only the fixed
        https://staging.allsourcedata.io/evaluation-test/ page and reject redirect

tools.name: configure_consent
tools.description:
Turn on and set up the consent bar for a pixel.

        Changing any setting makes a new policy version, and returning visitors are asked again.
        Returns the policy link and the script tag to put on the site.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description:
Hosted privacy and data-use policy HTML for a pixel.

        A pixel with consent turned off has no policy yet.

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description:
Contacts for one pixel.

        Pass on as a UTC day, or after as the high_water from the previous pull. Use high_water as the next cursor.
        New contacts can arrive between reads. This does not identify new visitors.
        Evaluation returns labeled synthetic examples only after current re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirm_signup, resend_code, get_pixel, get_policy · Private data: try_sample, signup_free, resend_code, create_api_key, whoami, create_pixel, get_contacts · Public sink: signup_free, confirm_signup, resend_code, create_api_key, whoami.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirm_signup, resend_code, get_pixel, get_policy · Private data: try_sample, signup_free, resend_code, create_api_key, whoami, create_pixel, get_contacts · Public sink: signup_free, confirm_signup, resend_code, create_api_key, whoami

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
